subject.title: Telegram detached subagents can run silently without liveness or terminal notification

question: Should this issue remain the canonical Telegram-visible detached-subagent liveness and terminal-delivery slice, or should its evidence be folded into the broader session activity and background-task completion work?
rationale: The implementation boundary spans Telegram transport UX, subagent/task state, heartbeat delivery, possible configuration, and open partial fixes, so automation should not choose the public delivery policy alone.

options.title: Keep Telegram slice
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Telegram-specific liveness and terminal-notification contract, while linking generic activity and completion-delivery work as dependencies.

options.title: Fold into generic activity work
options.body: Move the Telegram evidence into broader session-activity/watchdog work only if a canonical item explicitly owns Telegram delivery semantics.

options.title: Wait for terminal-delivery PR
options.body: Defer liveness implementation until the owner-session completion-delivery candidate lands or is rejected.

recommendation.title: Keep Telegram slice
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Telegram-specific liveness and terminal-notification contract, while linking generic activity and completion-delivery work as dependencies.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the best available owner from the current blame/history because the decision must coordinate the central subagent, task, heartbeat, and Telegram typing paths.
